definitions.explanation: The act of copying or imitating someone or something, whether in art, behavior, or technique. Often carries a neutral or slightly negative nuance, suggesting a lack of originality. Can be used as a suru-verb. Composed of 模 (model/pattern) + 倣 (emulate).

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{模倣|もほう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{模倣|もほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない。
examples.english: This work is nothing more than an imitation of a famous painter.

examples.japanese: {模倣|もほう}⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Care must be taken in how things are reported in order to prevent copycat crimes.

notes:
USAGE:
{模倣|もほう} is more formal than ⟦{真似|まね}→真似：03736_mane⟧ (imitation/mimicry). It is commonly used in academic, artistic, and media contexts. It can function as a suru-verb: {模倣|もほう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to imitate).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {模倣|もほう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to imitate)
- {模倣|もほう}⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧ (copycat crime)
- {模倣|もほう}{品|ひん} (imitation product, counterfeit)
- {模倣|もほう}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (imitator)
- {模倣|もほう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧ (start from imitation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{真似|まね}→真似：03736_mane⟧ is the everyday word for "imitation" or "mimicry" and is less formal. ⟦{模写|もしゃ}→模写：19473_mosha⟧ specifically refers to copying a painting or artwork. ⟦{偽造|ぎぞう}→偽造：11524_gizou⟧ means "forgery" or "counterfeiting" and implies illegal intent.
